name: South Bay Circuits, Inc.
old_description: South Bay Circuits, Inc. is a printed circuit board manufacturer in Chandler, Arizona, offering circuit fabrication, assembly, backplane assembly, card cage services, and testing.
about:
South Bay Circuits, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Chandler, Arizona. The company began as a printed circuit board manufacturer and has grown into a single-source provider of electronic manufacturing services.

The company operates a 60,000-square-foot facility where it provides PCB design and layout, fabrication through manufacturing partners, circuit card assembly (CCA), backplane assembly, box build, and a range of testing services including automated optical inspection, X-ray verification, in-circuit and functional testing. It supports prototype through production volumes, offering turnaround times as short as 24 hours for layout and same-day assembly for urgent orders.

South Bay Circuits serves customers in medical, industrial, power conversion, instrumentation, automotive, semiconductor, telecommunications, computer storage, contract manufacturing, aerospace and defense, and consumer electronics sectors. Its client base includes original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers seeking domestic and offshore production options.

The company emphasizes its "Single Source Solutions" model, aiming to reduce new-product-introduction time and manage cost through integrated design, fabrication, assembly, and test under one roof. It highlights its USA-based manufacturing as a way to avoid overseas delays and tariffs, and it maintains ITAR registration and CMMC Level 1 compliance for defense work.
